learning_outcomes.text: Understand basic refrigeration information and various methods of storing substances.
Learn refrigeration cycles using mechanical installation diagrams and thermodynamic diagrams.
Understand the functions of refrigeration circuit elements and perform sizing.
Understand the importance of insulation in spaces where refrigeration will be applied.
Know how to evaluate the physical and chemical properties of fluids that can be used in refrigeration circuits, as well as their environmental effects.
Know how to design and project refrigeration systems.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts of refrigeration and P-h diagram
Refrigeration circuit elements (compressor, condenser, cooling tower, expansion valve, evaporator, other elements)
Basic information on refrigeration and methods of storing food items
Refrigeration circuits operating with condensing vapor, P-h diagram
COP, heating effect coefficient for heat pumps
Achieving performance increase in absorption refrigeration cycles
Compressors, Condensers, cooling towers, expansion valves
Evaporators and other circuit elements functions and selection criteria
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated based on 50% for in-year success (midterm and homework) and 50% for the final exam. The in-year success comprises 70% from the midterm exam and 30% from homework. There is no information regarding minimum marks or resit arrangements.
bibliography: ASHRAE Handbook: “Fundamentals, Systems, Equipment, application Volume”, 2001,2002,2003,2004.
